card.name: Words that point to another passage
card.fires_on: Words that point the reader elsewhere, such as "see", "as" in "as recited in", "contained in" and "the following". Also "aforesaid" in legal text.

modes.label: Cross-reference cues
modes.description: "see" or "in" just before a pointer to a figure, section or reference.
